articles.title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour Final Map Revealed
articles.summary: The next map confirmed for Crazy Taxi: World Tour is India, boasting three different zones that celebrate the country’s many cultures and hallmarks — and yes, Bollywood films make an appearance.
body: Crazy Taxi: World Tour will boast five international maps: the US West Coast, Germany, Japan, Brazil, and finally, India. The India map will feature three distinct zones, labeled City, Countryside, and Industrial.

The City zone is all hustle and bustle, with vibrant marketplaces, nightlife, and architecture. The Country zone is where you can find ancient temples and zoom through the natural landscape, while the Industrial zone takes players on a tour of its trade and commerce hubs, as well as a look at one of the world’s oldest trains.
The game’s official trailer for the India map even teases that players might find themselves on the “set of a Bollywood film,” showing a passenger holding a camera who appears to be a movie director.

In the Pickup Race mode, up to 6 players compete to drop off as many passengers as possible within a specific time limit and earn as much cash as they can. In Cops ‘N’ Cabbies, two teams of players face off against each other, with one being cabbies and the other being cops hot on their trail.
points: The next map confirmed for Crazy Taxi: World Tour is India, boasting three different zones that celebrate the country’s many cultures and hallmarks — and yes, Bollywood films make an appearance.

articles.title: The Lenovo Legion Pro 7i Combines Gaming, Versatility, and Portability in One Premium Package
articles.summary: In our increasingly digital era, what we require from our laptops has expanded exponentially. Gone are the days of only caring about how well they run games and Microsoft Office. Now we also need them for content creation, our jobs, schoolwork, and with a design you can take on the go.
body: The Lenovo Legion Pro 7i addresses all those needs, providing the versatility and flexibility to shift between tasks seamlessly while also having the power to deliver a high-end gaming experience.

We’re unabashed gamers at IGN, so gaming performance is always going to be a major focus for us with laptops. The Lenovo Legion Pro 7i delivers in that regard, thanks to Intel Core Ultra 9 processors that enable high peak performance. Combined with its full-speed 2.5G ethernet and HDMI 2.1, it performs more like a desktop.

It also has the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50 Series graphics card, either the 5070, 5080, or 5090. The latter two options provide a full 175W of power, which really unlocks the elite performance of the machine. The gaming experience is completed by a gorgeous 16-inch OLED display with 16:10 aspect ratio, 240 Hz refresh rate, and wide color gamut. It uses Lenovo PureSight to maintain crystal clear image quality and smooth motion. Put simply, if you’re looking for top-of-the-line gaming, this has it.

articles.title: Official Zelda Website Raises Eyebrows By Labeling 3DS Game As Playable On Switch
articles.summary: Nintendo is celebrating The Legend of Zelda's 40th anniversary in many different ways, but one detail on the company's official website raised confusion--and curiosity-- about a classic 3DS Zelda game.
body: The site appropriately labels the Zelda games featured on Nintendo Classics if they are only playable with the Nintendo Switch Online Expansion Pack subscription, which applies to Ocarina of Time ( the original ), Majora's Mask, A Link to the Past/Four Swords on GBA, The Wind Waker, and The Minish Cap.

If this labeling for A Link Between Worlds were true, it would be surprising if the Expansion Pack were not required to play it. Nintendo Classics also lacks any Wii or DS games, so jumping straight to 3DS would be a bizarre move for the service.

Whatever the case, A Link Between Worlds is a magnificent entry in the Zelda series that deserves to be experienced. GameSpot's 9/10 review of the game called it an "absolute treat to play" with some of the "best Zelda dungeons in years."

articles.title: Marvel Confirms the Avengers Team Lineup That Anthony Mackie's Captain America Will Lead in Doomsday
articles.summary: Marvel has confirmed the lineup of heroes that Anthony Mackie's Captain America will lead into battle when Avengers: Doomsday premieres next month. Which portion of the big team-up movie's ensemble cast will fall specifically into the Avengers camp was confirmed by Empire.
body: With so many different teams from across the MCU multiverse to keep track of, you may have been a bit confused about who was fighting who and which superpowered being was on whose side. For Mackie, returning as Captain America means leading a new team, and that team now officially encompasses him, Falcon (Danny Ramirez), Ant-Man (Paul Rudd), Thor (Chris Hemsworth), and Shang-Chi (Simu Liu).

The full team includes faces new and old as Earth's Mightiest Heroes band together to fight off Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom. It'll be far from Mackie's first rodeo as Sam Wilson, but donning the Captain America mantle represents a completely new moment not only for himself but for the characters he's leading. He opened up about the role change during the interview.
"In Endgame, Steve gave him the shield and says, 'You need to be the leader of the Avengers,'" he said. "Now you get to see more of him leading the charge with everyone into battle."

articles.title: A PlayStation 5 Compatible SSD With Heatsink Dropped to Possibly the Lowest Price We'll See for Black Friday
articles.summary: If you're an avid PS5 gamer, sooner or later you're going to need more storage. Grand Theft Auto 6, which comes out this month, will take up over 200GB of space alone. That's nearly 25% of your stock 1TB storage space, since a 1TB PS5 drive really equates to less than 850GB of usable storage.
body: Unfortunately, PlayStation storage deals are practically non-existent in 2026... but that changes today. Ahead of Black Friday, Walmart just dropped the price of the Verbatim Vi7000 1TB PlayStation 5 compatible solid state drive (SSD) to just $129 with free shipping. This is the lowest price I've seen for a high-speed 1TB SSD in months. If you want even more storage, the 2TB model is also on sale for $199. Both models even include a built-in heatsink. Never say never, but I think we'll be hard pressed to find a better price than this during Black Friday proper.

The Verbatim Vi7000 is Playstation 5 compatible. That means it fulfills all of Sony's requirements. It boasts sequential speeds of 7000MB/s read and 6500MB/s write, which easily surpasses the minimum recommended speed of 5,500MB/s. The SSD uses the PCI-Express Gen4x4 interface which slots neatly into the PS5's drive bay. It also has a preinstalled heatsink that will do a fine job of keeping your SSD cool.

articles.title: GTA 6 And These Other Games Can Justify An $80 Price, Expert Says
articles.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 finally releases on November 19, and you'll have to pay at least $80 for it. That's a full $20 more than what GTA 5 cost in 2013 and $10 more than many other big AAA games today.
body: According to Alinea Analytics researcher Rhys Elliott, $80 won't be an across-the-board new price for all games. Some developers will purposefully price their games lower to draw in more consumers--he pointed to games like Expedition 33 ($50), Phantom Blade Zero ($60), and Oblivion Remastered ($50) as examples.

Elliott said that when GTA 6 inevitably becomes a huge success with its $80 and $100 editions, some publishers will be "jumping for joy" because they'll take this as a signal that the market will indeed accept these higher prices.

However, Elliott said he hopes the industry doesn't learn the wrong lessons from GTA 6 and its $80 price point. "GTA 6 is as inelastic as things get in entertainment. People will pay anything to get their mitts on this one, which makes it seem like the perfect Trojan horse for an industry-wide price rise," he said.

"The $80 price point will be a Godsend to some publishers, but it’ll be a snowball's chance in hell for others. After all, this kind of stuff can be zero-sum. When a player spends $100 on GTA 6, their remaining budget shrinks," he added.

articles.title: Magic: The Gathering Animated Series Officially Gets First Trailer
articles.summary: Magic: The Gathering is finally getting a TV show, and publisher Wizards of the Coast just debuted the first official look at the animated series during its MagicCon Atlanta preview panel.
body: During the panel, Wizards revealed the official name of the show: Planeswalker.

Planeswalker will focus on a young Chandra Nalaar and her mentor Ajani Goldmane, Wizards said, and the series will feature a variety of art styles based on the planes that Chandra and Ajana visit. The animated series is set to debut in 2027.

In June 2019, Netflix announced that it was working on a Magic: The Gathering TV series that would be executive produced by the Russo brothers. Henry Gilroy, who co-wrote Star Wars: The Clone Wars, and Jose Molina, who worked on Agent Carter, were set as the lead writers. Bardel Entertainment, the studio known for Rick and Morty, Teen Titans Go!, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2012), and The Dragon Prince, was going to handle animation. Then came a lengthy radio silence.

Deadline reported in August 2021 that the Russo brothers had departed the project, with a new creative team in place led by executive producer Jeff Kline ( Transformers: Prime ). Kline was chosen to oversee an all-new storyline focused on Planeswalkers. Snowball Studios stepped in for animation.

articles.title: The PS5’s New Graphics-Upscaling Trick Is Spreading To More Games
articles.summary: Sony has announced that several more games are getting a Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR) upgrade on PS5. Introduced in September, QSSR is an AI-guided upscaling technology similar to the PS5 Pro's PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR), and it originally supported only Marvel's…
body: While it's not quite as good as PSSR on the PS5 Pro, QSSR still does a noticeable job of adding detail and clarity without impacting performance. Sony added that since QSSR shares elements with PSSR, it makes games that support the PS5 Pro upscaling tech a "natural" fit for an upgrade on regular PS5 consoles.

Marvel's Spider-Man 2 is a good example, given Insomniac Games' familiarity with PSSR. The QSSR update is now available for the game, and Insomniac's head of technology, Mike Fitzgerald, said it'll apply to both Fidelity and Performance modes. For Control Resonant, Remedy Entertainment senior graphics programmer Erik Jansson said that QSSR will offer noticeable improvements in image stability and fine detail, and the update will be available in December.

articles.title: VisionQuest’s Wild Post-Credits Cameo Almost Didn’t Happen
articles.summary: If you haven't already heard about the shocking return of a fan-favorite Avenger at the end of VisionQuest, then you should beware spoilers ahead. For everyone who hasn't been under a rock, the latest Marvel series made waves this week by reviving Wanda Maximoff in a post-credits scene.
body: Originally, however, Marvel Studios' boss didn't want the cameo to happen at all.

Talking to The Playlist in the wake of VisionQuest 's finale, star Paul Bettany admitted that Kevin Feige cautioned against including Wanda. The Marvel boss told Bettany and showrunner Terry Matalas that they had "done such a great job at making me care about Vision. I really don't think you should distract from that by giving the audience that at the end of the [show]." As Bettany recounts, Feige wanted VisionQuest to stand on its own and thought Wanda's return would overshadow it. With the show finally over, it seems like Feige wasn't entirely wrong.

Bettany hasn't said anything regarding whether he will appear in Doomsday, but he told The Playlist that he would love for another Vision series to happen. While he admitted that it doesn't seem likely at the moment, he added, "My experience of Hollywood tells me if something’s a big enough hit, people want to continue with that. So I mean, I guess we’ll see."

articles.title: All rupee wallet upgrade locations in Zelda Ocarina of Time
articles.summary: Upgrading the r upee wallet allows you to hold five times the original amount of rupees in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. As things have gotten a bit pricier Hyrule, you'll need a larger rupee wallet if you want to purchase everything you need, like the abilities given to you by the…
body: Although you can collect rupees by cutting grass and killing enemies from the early hours in the game, you can only carry a limited number of them. If you reach the cap, you will have to leave the rupees you find behind, and we all know that in this economy, Link can't waste money.
To help you make Link's pocket large enough to carry all the money you can find, we've put together this guide showing all rupee wallet upgrade locations in Ocarina of Time remake.

You begin the game being able to carry only 200 rupees, but with the upgrades, you can increase this number to up to 1,000 rupees. There are two rupee wallet upgrades in the game, the Adult's Wallet and the Giant's Wallet.

You will find these two rupee wallet upgrades in the same place: Kakariko Village. More precisely, you obtain them by talking to the Cursed Rich Man inside the house on the southeast side of Kakariko Village after completing his requests.

articles.title: Dragon Age Modders Are Rushing to Save the Series’ Most Iconic Feature
articles.summary: One of the Dragon Age series' most well-known features is now safe, thanks to the efforts of a modder. After EA shut down BioWare a few weeks ago, many fans realized the studio’s closure probably meant it would soon become impossible to easily port save data between all the games.
body: When Dragon Age: Origins released in 2009, BioWare emphasized that player decisions would permanently impact the land of Thedas. Dragon Age 2 lets players carry over their choices from the previous game by reading data stored on your system's hard drive, but things got tricky with Dragon Age: Inquisition, which was released on the next generation of consoles. Because BioWare couldn’t rely on players using the same system they had previously for Inquisition, they had to take a different approach.

The studio created a website called the Dragon Age Keep, which lets players tailor the decisions made in Dragon Age: Origins and Dragon Age 2 so they can be ported into Dragon Age: Inquisition via an EA account. The Keep was the only way to transfer a player’s previous world state into Inquisition, allowing for around 300 choices. While the Keep is still working, it seems fair to expect that EA will shut it down now that BioWare is no longer there to maintain the site.
points: One of the Dragon Age series' most well-known features is now safe, thanks to the efforts of a modder.

articles.title: A new report reckons 40% of developers in the video games industry are using generative AI - but even more think it's harmful
articles.summary: Despite all the outrage and criticism around game developers and publishers using generative AI in gaming, a new report from the Game Developers Conference (GDC) calculates that as many as 40 percent of developers active in the industry use the controversial tools in their work.
body: That's according to the latest State of the Game Industry report from GDC, which gathers data from more than 2,300 respondents including, but not limited to, game industry professionals, made up of developers, producers, marketers, executives, and investors.

The report notes that 57 percent of developers who say they do use it, use gen-AI for "text generation, research, early prototyping, coding, and presentations". There appears to be a big split between triple-A studios that use gen-AI (with 27 percent of triple-A developers noting that they "feel encouraged or pressured" to use it) and indie devs, of which only nine percent say the same. Perhaps unsurprisingly - given how vocally against gen-AI a lot of 'frontline developers' have been - the tools are mostly used by "business operations and services, mobile-only studios, and free-to-play developers".

There seems to be a gap in the ages of those willing to use AI tools as well; per the report, over half (54 percent) of people 45 years or older reported using the tools - an eight-point increase from last year's survey. There is also more usage among men (45 percent) than women (33 percent).

videos.title: Bombanana! - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
videos.summary: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?
body: - 3-Player Co-op: No more, no less. Exactly three monkeys required.
- Campaign: 30 handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty.
- Endless: Procedurally generated, wave-based levels that keep getting harder.
points: Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf and mute monkeys.
Each player has only part of the needed information.
